name: Aiden Lapierre
intro: I'm Aiden, a student in the Netherlands. I photograph places and moving subjects, take part in Model UN, and build electronics and computing projects.

galleries.title: Landscape
galleries.description: Natural environments, changing light and the details of a place.

projects.title: FPV drone
projects.summary: Designing and assembling an FPV drone, with soldering and electronics assembly as the main learning focus.
projects.description: This project brings together electronics, assembly and flight-system learning. The portfolio will document the build and the decisions behind the system.

projects.title: Soldering & electronics
projects.summary: Developing soldering skills through hands-on electronics work.
projects.description: A record of soldering practice, connections and electronics assembly. Build photographs and observations will show how my technique develops.

projects.title: Fixed-wing aircraft
projects.summary: Exploring printable aircraft structures, modular parts and endurance-focused design.
projects.description: A design exploration using CAD and 3D printing. This page will record geometry, component choices and development revisions. No flight validation is claimed.

projects.title: Raspberry Pi
projects.summary: Learning about small computers, networking and self-hosted services.
projects.description: A space to document Raspberry Pi experiments, configurations and what I learn from running services.

projects.title: Home servers & storage
projects.summary: Working with NAS storage, Proxmox and self-hosted services.
projects.description: My home lab combines servers, network storage and virtualisation. This page will document the setup and the problems I work through.

projects.title: Radio communications
projects.summary: Studying amateur radio and learning about radio communications.
projects.description: An interest in radio systems, antennas and communications. This is a learning record, with no radio qualification claimed.

projects.title: Programming experiments
projects.summary: Small programming projects and engineering experiments.
projects.description: A flexible record of programming work, approaches I try and problems I solve.
